trials.title: Peek Inside a List

choices.label: coral
choices.explanation: `coral` is at position `2` (or `-1`).

postBoss.text: No! My 16-Bit Throne is shattered! Retreating to the 32-Bit Frontier!

postBoss.speaker: Zenith
postBoss.text: All sixteen dragons fly free! Feel the horizon bend: the 3D Era of Pyria is waking up!

postBoss.speaker: Pip
postBoss.text: 16-Bit Era complete! Step through the portal into the 32-Bit Frontier!
